rationale: Y catches more of the ground-truth P1 concerns in substance (combined-mode memory/perf-validation gap explicitly discussed with the 270GiB figure and MUSA caution quote; the TTS/generic task-type validation regression matches exactly; the cache-dit generalization issue is investigated in the same code area even if manifested differently via Bagel/SenseNova rather than the exact transformers_ref case). X matches only the task-type validation item and misses the modular-metadata bug, the Ref2VA default-task regression, the cache-dit combined-DiT gap, and the memory table — plus one of X's 'claim-verified' assertions (that DiffusionModelMetadata correctly duplicates admission limits) is actually contradicted by the ground truth, which found that exact metadata undersized. Both reports are well-evidenced with file/line citations and concrete fixes, so actionability and precision are comparably high, but Y's broader and more accurate coverage of real GT concerns gives it the edge.
